title.en: Just Got a Green Card? Health Insurance Options 2026
title.es: ¿Obtuvo la Tarjeta Verde? Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

description.en: Getting a green card triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. Learn the 5-year Medicaid bar, ACA Marketplace eligibility, and state programs for 2026.
description.es: Tarjeta verde activa SEP de 60 dias. Conozca la barra de 5 anos de Medicaid, elegibilidad del Mercado ACA y programas estatales en 2026.

h1.en: Just Got Your Green Card? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options in 2026
h1.es: ¿Acaba de Obtener su Tarjeta Verde? Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico en 2026

subhero.en: Receiving lawful permanent resident status gives you a 60-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in ACA Marketplace coverage. The federal 5-year bar blocks most green card holders from Medicaid for their first 5 years, but the ACA Marketplace is open to you from Day 1.
subhero.es: Recibir el estatus de residente permanente legal le da un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para inscribirse en el Mercado ACA. La barra federal de 5 anos bloquea a la mayoria de los titulares de tarjeta verde de Medicaid durante sus primeros 5 anos, pero el Mercado ACA esta abierto para usted desde el Dia 1.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your green card approval date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de aprobacion de su tarjeta verde

body.en: Your 60-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period runs from the date you receive lawful permanent resident status, for example from June 11 through August 10, 2026 if your green card was approved on June 11, 2026. Miss this window and you may have to wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 for coverage starting January 2027. Medicaid does not carry this deadline in most states once the 5-year waiting period ends or if you qualify for an exemption.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado de 60 dias comienza desde la fecha en que recibe el estatus de residente permanente legal, por ejemplo del 11 de junio al 10 de agosto de 2026 si su tarjeta verde fue aprobada el 11 de junio de 2026. Si pierde esta ventana, es posible que tenga que esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta de ACA en noviembre de 2026 para cobertura a partir de enero de 2027.

label.es: Medicaid para ninos y mujeres embarazadas (38 estados, todo el ano)

quickAnswer.en: Receiving a green card (lawful permanent resident status) triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan. Most green card holders face a federal 5-year waiting period before qualifying for Medicaid or CHIP, established by PRWORA 1996 (8 U.S.C. 1612). Exceptions apply to refugees, asylees, veterans, and people with 40 quarters of U.S. work history. In 2026, green card holders with income at or above 100% of the Federal Poverty Level qualify for Marketplace premium tax credits. Thirty-eight states plus DC waive the 5-year bar for children and pregnant women under Medicaid or CHIP. California's Medi-Cal and a handful of other states offer state-funded coverage to income-eligible lawful permanent residents during the waiting period.
quickAnswer.es: Recibir una tarjeta verde (estatus de residente permanente legal) activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA. La mayoria de los titulares de tarjeta verde enfrentan un periodo de espera federal de 5 anos antes de calificar para Medicaid o CHIP, establecido por la ley PRWORA 1996. Exenciones aplican para refugiados, asylees, veteranos y personas con 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU. En 2026, los titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califican para creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado. Treinta y ocho estados mas DC renuncian a la barra de 5 anos para ninos y mujeres embarazadas bajo Medicaid o CHIP.

introParagraphs.en: Receiving a green card is one of the most significant milestones for immigrants in the United States, and it immediately changes how you can access health insurance. Lawful permanent resident status makes you eligible to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan during a 60-day Special Enrollment Period, beginning the day your green card is approved. Premium tax credits are available to green card holders with income at or above 100% of the Federal Poverty Level in 2026, which means a family of four earning at least $33,000 per year can receive substantial subsidies. Many new green card holders are surprised to learn that the ACA Marketplace is fully available to them without any waiting period. The federal 5-year bar for Medicaid, created under the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 (PRWORA), means that most lawful permanent residents who entered the U.S. on or after August 22, 1996, must wait five years before qualifying for federally funded Medicaid. This rule applies to full Medicaid coverage but does not prevent you from using the ACA Marketplace.
introParagraphs.es: Recibir una tarjeta verde es uno de los hitos mas importantes para los inmigrantes en los Estados Unidos, y cambia inmediatamente como puede acceder al seguro de salud. El estatus de residente permanente legal le hace elegible para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA durante un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias, comenzando el dia en que se aprueba su tarjeta verde. Los creditos fiscales de prima estan disponibles para titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en 2026, lo que significa que una familia de cuatro que gane al menos $33,000 por ano puede recibir subsidios sustanciales. Muchos nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde se sorprenden al saber que el Mercado ACA esta completamente disponible para ellos sin periodo de espera. La barra federal de 5 anos para Medicaid, creada bajo la Ley de Reconciliacion de Responsabilidad Personal y Oportunidades de Trabajo de 1996 (PRWORA), significa que la mayoria de los residentes permanentes legales que ingresaron a los EE.UU. el 22 de agosto de 1996 o despues deben esperar cinco anos antes de calificar para Medicaid financiado federalmente.

introParagraphs.en: Two important pathways open to new green card holders in 2026: the ACA Marketplace with possible premium tax credits from Day 1, and state-funded programs for those in the 5-year waiting period if you live in California, New York, Illinois, or a handful of other states. Children and pregnant women often have immediate Medicaid eligibility in 38 states regardless of the 5-year bar. Special exemptions to the Medicaid 5-year bar include refugees, asylees, Cuban-Haitian entrants, veterans and active-duty service members, people with 40 quarters of U.S. work history, and lawful permanent residents who previously held asylee or refugee status. Understanding which path fits your household, your income, and your state is what this guide covers. The ACA income limits for subsidies in 2026 are set at 100% to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level, and Medicaid income limits after the 5-year bar are set at 138% FPL in expansion states. Applying through healthcare.gov remains the fastest way to check your eligibility and enroll within the 60-day window.
introParagraphs.es: Dos caminos importantes se abren para los nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde en 2026: el Mercado ACA con posibles creditos fiscales de prima desde el Dia 1, y programas financiados por el estado para quienes estan en el periodo de espera de 5 anos si vive en California, Nueva York, Illinois u otros pocos estados. Los ninos y las mujeres embarazadas a menudo tienen elegibilidad inmediata para Medicaid en 38 estados independientemente de la barra de 5 anos. Las exenciones especiales a la barra de 5 anos de Medicaid incluyen refugiados, asylees, cubanos y haitianos, veteranos y militares activos, personas con 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU., y residentes permanentes legales que previamente tuvieron estatus de asylee o refugiado.

name.en: Confirm your green card approval date (your SEP start date)
name.es: Confirme la fecha de aprobacion de su tarjeta verde (su fecha de inicio del SEP)

text.en: The 60-day Special Enrollment Period begins on the date you received lawful permanent resident status, which is the approval date on your Form I-551 (green card). Log in to your USCIS online account or check your approval notice to confirm the exact date. You have 60 days from that date to enroll in a Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov.
text.es: El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias comienza en la fecha en que recibio el estatus de residente permanente legal, que es la fecha de aprobacion en su Formulario I-551 (tarjeta verde). Inicie sesion en su cuenta en linea de USCIS o revise su aviso de aprobacion para confirmar la fecha exacta. Tiene 60 dias desde esa fecha para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado en healthcare.gov.

name.en: Check for a 5-year bar exemption before applying for Medicaid
name.es: Verifique si tiene una exencion a la barra de 5 anos antes de solicitar Medicaid

text.en: Apply immediately at your state Medicaid agency or healthcare.gov if you are a refugee, asylee, Cuban-Haitian entrant, veteran, active-duty service member, or have 40 quarters of U.S. work history. Children and pregnant women may qualify for Medicaid or CHIP in 38 states regardless of the 5-year bar. Most other new green card holders must wait 5 years from the date they obtained lawful permanent resident status before qualifying for federally funded Medicaid in the 40 expansion states.
text.es: Aplique inmediatamente en la agencia de Medicaid de su estado o healthcare.gov si es refugiado, asylee, entrante cubano-haitiano, veterano, militar activo, o tiene 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU. Los ninos y las mujeres embarazadas pueden calificar para Medicaid o CHIP en 38 estados independientemente de la barra de 5 anos.

name.en: Calculate your 2026 household income to determine Marketplace subsidy eligibility
name.es: Calcule su ingreso del hogar 2026 para determinar la elegibilidad para subsidios del Mercado

text.en: ACA Marketplace premium tax credits are available to green card holders with income at or above 100% of the Federal Poverty Level in 2026 ($15,960 for a single person, $33,000 for a family of four). Use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) to calculate your projected 2026 annual income. If your income is below 100% FPL and you do not qualify for Medicaid due to the 5-year bar, check whether your state offers a state-funded program. The 400% FPL subsidy ceiling ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four) returned for 2026 after enhanced PTCs expired on January 1, 2026.
text.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA estan disponibles para titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en 2026 ($15,960 para una persona sola, $33,000 para una familia de cuatro). Use el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para calcular su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026.

name.en: Enroll through healthcare.gov or your state Marketplace within 60 days
name.es: Inscribase a traves de healthcare.gov o el Mercado de su estado en 60 dias

text.en: Open healthcare.gov and create an account. Select 'New lawful permanent resident' as your qualifying life event when prompted. Upload a copy of your Form I-551 (green card) or your USCIS approval notice as proof of the qualifying event. Choose a Silver or Bronze plan depending on your budget. Silver plans offer the best value for most subsidized enrollees because Cost-Sharing Reductions apply at Silver only. Submit your application before the 60-day window closes to lock in coverage retroactive to your green card date or the date after you apply, depending on the plan and state.
text.es: Abra healthcare.gov y cree una cuenta. Seleccione 'Nuevo residente permanente legal' como su evento calificador de vida cuando se le solicite. Cargue una copia de su Formulario I-551 (tarjeta verde) o su aviso de aprobacion de USCIS como prueba del evento calificador. Elija un plan Silver o Bronze segun su presupuesto.

name.en: Check your state for coverage during the 5-year waiting period
name.es: Verifique si su estado ofrece cobertura durante el periodo de espera de 5 anos

text.en: California's Medi-Cal, New York's Essential Plan (state-funded for lawfully present immigrants losing federal subsidy eligibility), and several other states offer coverage options for income-eligible lawful permanent residents during the 5-year Medicaid waiting period. Check your state Medicaid agency website or call your state's Medicaid helpline. The Medicaid income limits after the 5-year bar end at 138% FPL in the 40 expansion states, which is $22,025 for one person or $45,540 for a family of four in 2026.
text.es: Medi-Cal de California, el Plan Esencial de Nueva York (financiado por el estado para inmigrantes con presencia legal que pierden la elegibilidad para subsidios federales), y varios otros estados ofrecen opciones de cobertura para residentes permanentes legales con ingresos elegibles durante el periodo de espera de Medicaid de 5 anos.

name.en: Track the 5-year anniversary of your green card approval
name.es: Registre el quinto aniversario de la aprobacion de su tarjeta verde

text.en: Mark the exact date five years from your lawful permanent resident approval date. Starting on that anniversary, submit a Medicaid application through your state Medicaid agency or healthcare.gov. Medicaid enrollment is year-round in all 40 expansion states, so there is no deadline to meet once the 5-year bar ends. Income at or below 138% FPL makes you eligible in expansion states. Your 1095-A tax form from your Marketplace plan will help reconcile any premium tax credits you received during the waiting period when you file your federal taxes.
text.es: Marque la fecha exacta de cinco anos a partir de la fecha de aprobacion de su residencia permanente legal. A partir de ese aniversario, presente una solicitud de Medicaid a traves de la agencia de Medicaid de su estado o healthcare.gov. La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano en los 40 estados de expansion, por lo que no hay plazo que cumplir una vez que termine la barra de 5 anos.

name.en: File your 1095-A at tax time to reconcile Marketplace premium tax credits
name.es: Presente su 1095-A en la temporada de impuestos para reconciliar los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado

text.en: If you enrolled in a Marketplace plan and received advance premium tax credits (APTC), healthcare.gov will mail you Form 1095-A by early February. Use Form 8962 to reconcile the credits on your federal tax return. Report any income changes during the year immediately at healthcare.gov to avoid a large repayment at tax time. Green card holders are treated the same as U.S. citizens for ACA subsidy purposes once they have lawfully present status.
text.es: Si se inscribio en un plan del Mercado y recibio creditos fiscales de prima anticipados (APTC), healthcare.gov le enviara el Formulario 1095-A a principios de febrero. Use el Formulario 8962 para reconciliar los creditos en su declaracion de impuestos federal. Reporte cualquier cambio de ingresos durante el ano inmediatamente en healthcare.gov para evitar un gran reembolso en la temporada de impuestos.

footnote.en: 2026 ACA Marketplace subsidy cliff: the 400% FPL ceiling ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of 4) returned January 1, 2026 after enhanced PTCs from ARPA/IRA expired. Green card holders in the 5-year waiting period are not eligible for Medicaid except through state-funded programs in select states. Public charge rule: applying for ACA Marketplace subsidies or Medicaid (if eligible) does NOT count against a public charge determination per USCIS policy as of 2026.
footnote.es: Tope de subsidio del Mercado ACA 2026: el limite del 400% FPL ($63,840 persona sola, $132,000 familia de 4) regreso el 1 de enero de 2026 despues de que los PTCs mejorados de ARPA/IRA expiraron. Los titulares de tarjeta verde en el periodo de espera de 5 anos no son elegibles para Medicaid excepto a traves de programas financiados por el estado en estados seleccionados. Regla de carga publica: solicitar subsidios del Mercado ACA o Medicaid (si es elegible) NO cuenta en contra de una determinacion de carga publica segun la politica de USCIS en 2026.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes green card holders make when navigating health insurance in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los titulares de tarjeta verde al gestionar el seguro de salud en 2026:

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. The Special Enrollment Period triggered by your green card lasts exactly 60 days. If you miss it without a second qualifying event, you wait until November 2026 Open Enrollment for January 2027 coverage.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias. El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial activado por su tarjeta verde dura exactamente 60 dias. Si lo pierde sin un segundo evento calificador, espera hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura a partir de enero de 2027.

items.en: Assuming the 5-year bar means no coverage options. The 5-year bar only blocks federal Medicaid. The ACA Marketplace is available from Day 1. State-funded programs exist in California, New York, Illinois, Washington, and other states.
items.es: Asumir que la barra de 5 anos significa que no hay opciones de cobertura. La barra de 5 anos solo bloquea Medicaid federal. El Mercado ACA esta disponible desde el Dia 1. Existen programas financiados por el estado en California, Nueva York, Illinois, Washington y otros estados.

items.en: Not checking for a 5-year bar exemption. Refugees, asylees, Cuban-Haitian entrants, veterans, and people with 40 quarters of U.S. work history qualify for Medicaid immediately without waiting. Not verifying your exemption status costs free coverage.
items.es: No verificar si tiene una exencion a la barra de 5 anos. Refugiados, asylees, entrants cubanos-haitianos, veteranos y personas con 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU. califican para Medicaid inmediatamente sin esperar.

items.en: Leaving children without coverage during the parent's waiting period. Thirty-eight states plus DC waive the 5-year bar for children under the ICHIA option. Children may qualify for CHIP or Medicaid even while parents are in the waiting period.
items.es: Dejar a los ninos sin cobertura durante el periodo de espera de los padres. Treinta y ocho estados mas DC renuncian a la barra de 5 anos para ninos bajo la opcion ICHIA. Los ninos pueden calificar para CHIP o Medicaid incluso mientras los padres estan en el periodo de espera.

items.en: Worrying that applying for ACA subsidies or Medicaid will hurt your immigration case. Receiving ACA Marketplace premium tax credits or Medicaid (if eligible) does NOT count as a public charge under current USCIS rules in 2026.
items.es: Preocuparse de que solicitar subsidios ACA o Medicaid perjudique su caso de inmigracion. Recibir creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA o Medicaid (si es elegible) NO cuenta como carga publica bajo las reglas actuales de USCIS en 2026.

items.en: Using an incorrect income estimate when applying for subsidies. Marketplace subsidies are based on projected 2026 MAGI income, not your income from a previous country. Report changes to healthcare.gov promptly to avoid reconciliation surprises on your 1095-A at tax time.
items.es: Usar una estimacion de ingresos incorrecta al solicitar subsidios. Los subsidios del Mercado se basan en el ingreso MAGI proyectado 2026, no en sus ingresos de un pais anterior. Reporte cambios a healthcare.gov rapidamente para evitar sorpresas de reconciliacion en su 1095-A en la temporada de impuestos.

heading.en: The Federal 5-Year Bar: What It Covers and What It Does Not
heading.es: La Barra Federal de 5 Anos: Que Cubre y Que No Cubre

paragraphs.en: Federal law under PRWORA 1996 (8 U.S.C. 1612) bars most lawful permanent residents who entered the U.S. on or after August 22, 1996, from receiving federally funded Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF, and SSI for the first five years after gaining qualified immigrant status. The five-year clock starts from the date you received lawful permanent resident status, not from the date you first entered the U.S. on a visa. Green card holders who entered on a work visa for several years before adjusting status start the 5-year countdown from the adjustment date.
paragraphs.es: La ley federal bajo PRWORA 1996 (8 U.S.C. 1612) prohibe a la mayoria de los residentes permanentes legales que entraron a los EE.UU. el 22 de agosto de 1996 o despues de recibir Medicaid financiado federalmente, CHIP, SNAP, TANF y SSI durante los primeros cinco anos despues de obtener el estatus de inmigrante calificado. El reloj de cinco anos comienza desde la fecha en que recibio el estatus de residente permanente legal, no desde la fecha en que entro por primera vez a los EE.UU. con una visa.

paragraphs.en: The ACA Marketplace is explicitly outside the 5-year bar. Congress did not classify ACA premium tax credits as a federal means-tested public benefit subject to PRWORA restrictions. Lawfully present immigrants, including those in the five-year waiting period, have been eligible to purchase Marketplace plans and receive premium tax credits since 2014. In 2026, green card holders with income at or above 100% FPL qualify for subsidies the same as any other lawfully present individual. The 400% FPL cliff ($63,840 for one person, $132,000 for a family of four) returned for 2026 after the enhanced PTCs expired.
paragraphs.es: El Mercado ACA esta explicitamente fuera de la barra de 5 anos. El Congreso no clasifico los creditos fiscales de prima ACA como un beneficio publico federal sujeto a las restricciones de PRWORA. Los inmigrantes con presencia legal, incluyendo aquellos en el periodo de espera de cinco anos, han podido comprar planes del Mercado y recibir creditos fiscales de prima desde 2014. En 2026, los titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% FPL califican para subsidios igual que cualquier otra persona con presencia legal.

paragraphs.en: Emergency Medicaid remains available to all immigrants, including undocumented individuals, regardless of the 5-year bar. Emergency Medicaid covers labor and delivery, emergency surgery, and other acute emergency services. Regular Medicaid for ongoing care, prescriptions, and preventive visits remains blocked until the 5-year bar expires or an exemption applies. Green card holders who qualify under an exemption (refugee, asylee, veteran, 40 quarters of work) can access full Medicaid immediately and should apply through their state Medicaid agency without waiting.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de emergencia sigue disponible para todos los inmigrantes, incluidos los indocumentados, independientemente de la barra de 5 anos. Medicaid de emergencia cubre el parto, la cirugia de emergencia y otros servicios de emergencia aguda. Medicaid regular para atencion continua, medicamentos recetados y visitas preventivas sigue bloqueado hasta que expire la barra de 5 anos o se aplique una exencion.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace vs State-Funded Programs: Which Is Better During the 5-Year Bar?
heading.es: Mercado ACA vs Programas Estatales: Cual Es Mejor Durante la Barra de 5 Anos?

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans give green card holders in the 5-year waiting period comprehensive coverage that follows federal essential health benefits standards. Subsidized premiums range from $0 to $300 per month depending on income and household size. Marketplace plans are available in all 50 states plus DC, so the option does not depend on your state of residence. The trade-off is that cost-sharing (deductibles, copays, out-of-pocket maximum) can still be significant. For 2026, the ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family. Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR), which lower deductibles and copays, are only available on Silver plans for households at or below 250% FPL.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA brindan a los titulares de tarjeta verde en el periodo de espera de 5 anos cobertura integral que sigue los estandares federales de beneficios esenciales de salud. Las primas subsidiadas oscilan entre $0 y $300 por mes dependiendo del ingreso y el tamano del hogar. Los planes del Mercado estan disponibles en los 50 estados mas DC, por lo que la opcion no depende de su estado de residencia.

paragraphs.en: State-funded programs fill the gap for income-eligible lawful permanent residents who cannot afford Marketplace premiums. California's Medi-Cal accepts income-eligible lawfully present immigrants who would otherwise qualify under the income rules but are barred by the five-year waiting period, though as of January 2026, California froze new enrollment for undocumented adults 19-64 and is applying new restrictions. New York maintains its Essential Plan using state-only funds for lawfully present immigrants who lose federal subsidy eligibility. Illinois operates a state-funded program for immigrant children and seniors. Washington's Apple Health, Oregon's Oregon Health Plan, and several other states have state-funded coverage options. Contact your state Medicaid agency to confirm current availability, as state program rules changed significantly in 2025-2026.
paragraphs.es: Los programas financiados por el estado llenan el vacio para los residentes permanentes legales con ingresos elegibles que no pueden pagar las primas del Mercado. Medi-Cal de California acepta inmigrantes con presencia legal con ingresos elegibles que de otro modo calificarian bajo las reglas de ingresos pero estan bloqueados por el periodo de espera de cinco anos. Nueva York mantiene su Plan Esencial usando fondos solo estatales para inmigrantes con presencia legal que pierden la elegibilidad para subsidios federales.

heading.en: State Rules and the 5-Year Bar: What Varies by State
heading.es: Reglas Estatales y la Barra de 5 Anos: Que Varia por Estado

paragraphs.en: Federal law sets the floor for the 5-year bar, but states have significant flexibility to expand coverage beyond it using state-only funds. As of 2026, the landscape divides into three tiers. First tier: California's Medi-Cal, New York's Essential Plan, Illinois (children and seniors), Washington State Apple Health, Oregon Health Plan, Massachusetts MassHealth, Connecticut HUSKY Health, and Vermont Green Mountain Care offer state-funded coverage to lawfully present immigrants in the five-year waiting period. Second tier: 38 states plus DC waive the 5-year bar for children and pregnant women under the ICHIA federal option, using a federal-state cost share. Third tier: the remaining states apply the 5-year bar strictly except for Emergency Medicaid.
paragraphs.es: La ley federal establece el piso para la barra de 5 anos, pero los estados tienen una flexibilidad significativa para ampliar la cobertura mas alla de ella usando fondos solo estatales. A partir de 2026, el panorama se divide en tres niveles. Primer nivel: Medi-Cal de California, Plan Esencial de Nueva York, Illinois (ninos y personas mayores), Apple Health de Washington, Oregon Health Plan, MassHealth de Massachusetts, HUSKY Health de Connecticut y Green Mountain Care de Vermont ofrecen cobertura financiada por el estado para inmigrantes con presencia legal en el periodo de espera de cinco anos.

paragraphs.en: The public charge rule is a major concern for new green card holders and one that causes many to avoid coverage they are legally entitled to. Under USCIS rules effective in 2026, the following benefits do NOT count as public charge: ACA Marketplace subsidies (premium tax credits), Medicaid for individuals under 21, Medicaid during pregnancy and 60 days postpartum, CHIP, emergency Medicaid, and state-funded health programs. Only receipt of cash assistance programs (TANF, SSI) and certain long-term institutional care under Medicaid counts for public charge purposes after USCIS's 2022 rule clarification. Applying for and receiving ACA Marketplace coverage or CHIP does not put your green card or future citizenship application at risk.
paragraphs.es: La regla de carga publica es una preocupacion importante para los nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde y una que hace que muchos eviten la cobertura a la que tienen derecho legalmente. Bajo las reglas de USCIS vigentes en 2026, los siguientes beneficios NO cuentan como carga publica: subsidios del Mercado ACA, Medicaid para personas menores de 21 anos, Medicaid durante el embarazo y 60 dias despues del parto, CHIP, Medicaid de emergencia y programas de salud financiados por el estado.

heading.en: Documents You Need to Enroll: Green Card SEP Application Checklist
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para Inscribirse: Lista de Verificacion para la Solicitud SEP de Tarjeta Verde

paragraphs.en: Applying for a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period based on gaining lawful permanent resident status requires specific documentation that differs from other SEP types. Healthcare.gov will prompt you for proof of your qualifying event. Submitting incomplete or unclear documentation is the most common cause of SEP denials for new green card holders. Upload all documents in clear, readable scans or photos. Keep copies of everything you submit.
paragraphs.es: Solicitar un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado basado en obtener el estatus de residente permanente legal requiere documentacion especifica que difiere de otros tipos de SEP. Healthcare.gov le pedira prueba de su evento calificador. Presentar documentacion incompleta o poco clara es la causa mas comun de denegaciones de SEP para nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde.

stateRules.rule: Medi-Cal covers income-eligible lawfully present immigrants during the 5-year waiting period. As of January 2026, California froze new enrollment for undocumented adults 19-64 but existing enrollees retain coverage. Lawfully present immigrants (including green card holders in the waiting period) who meet income limits (138% FPL for expansion coverage) continue to qualify.

New York maintains state-funded Essential Plan coverage for lawfully present immigrants losing federal subsidy eligibility, and is required by court order to provide state-funded coverage to lawfully present immigrants who would qualify for Medicaid but for their immigration status.
Illinois operates state-funded Medicaid coverage for immigrant children and seniors (65+). As of July 2025, Illinois ended state-funded coverage for immigrant adults aged 42-64.
Apple Health (Washington Medicaid) extends coverage to low-income lawfully present immigrants under state-only funds for children and pregnant women, and some additional categories.
MassHealth covers lawfully present immigrants who meet income requirements through state-funded programs, including those in the 5-year waiting period for federal Medicaid.
HUSKY Health (Connecticut Medicaid) covers lawfully present children and pregnant women who would qualify for Medicaid but for their immigration status, using state funds.

en: Missing the 60-day SEP window from the green card approval date before applying at healthcare.gov
Submitting incomplete documentation of the qualifying event (Form I-551 not uploaded or unreadable)
Applying for Medicaid without a 5-year bar exemption (most new green card holders face the 5-year federal waiting period)
Using prior-country income or old salary instead of projected 2026 U.S. income for subsidy eligibility calculations
Incorrectly reporting income below 100% FPL when in the 5-year waiting period (those below 100% FPL without a state program are caught in a coverage gap for federal subsidies)
es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha de aprobacion de la tarjeta verde antes de solicitar en healthcare.gov
Presentar documentacion incompleta del evento calificador (Formulario I-551 no cargado o ilegible)
Solicitar Medicaid sin una exencion a la barra de 5 anos (la mayoria de los nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde enfrentan el periodo de espera federal de 5 anos)
Usar ingresos del pais anterior o salario antiguo en lugar del ingreso proyectado en EE.UU. para 2026 para los calculos de elegibilidad para subsidios

Reportar ingresos incorrectamente por debajo del 100% FPL cuando esta en el periodo de espera de 5 anos (los que estan por debajo del 100% FPL sin un programa estatal quedan atrapados en una brecha de cobertura para subsidios federales)

heading.en: ACA Marketplace vs Medicaid vs State Programs: Which Should New Green Card Holders Choose?
heading.es: Mercado ACA vs Medicaid vs Programas Estatales: Cual Deben Elegir los Nuevos Titulares de Tarjeta Verde?

body.en: New green card holders in 2026 face a three-tier decision tree shaped by the federal 5-year Medicaid bar and state-specific programs. Tier 1: Medicaid exemption first. Refugees, asylees, veterans, and people with 40 quarters of U.S. work history qualify for full Medicaid immediately, for free, year-round. Applying through your state Medicaid agency or healthcare.gov and presenting the right exemption documentation gets you into the strongest coverage without any premium. Tier 2: State-funded program if income is low and you are in the 5-year waiting period. California's Medi-Cal, New York's Essential Plan, Washington's Apple Health, Massachusetts's MassHealth, and Connecticut's HUSKY Health extend free or low-cost coverage to income-eligible lawfully present immigrants during the waiting period. If you live in one of these states and your income is below 138% FPL, check the state program before paying Marketplace premiums. Tier 3: ACA Marketplace for everyone else. Green card holders with income at or above 100% FPL who live in a state without a state-funded program, or who have income above Medicaid levels, should enroll in a Marketplace plan within the 60-day SEP. Silver plans with Cost-Sharing Reductions are the best value at 100-250% FPL. Bronze plans with high deductibles work best for healthy individuals above 250% FPL with emergency-only risk tolerance. Unsubsidized full-premium Marketplace plans (for income above 400% FPL) cost $400 to $1,200 per month depending on age, household size, and state, but offer portable, comprehensive coverage that follows federal essential health benefit rules.
body.es: Los nuevos titulares de tarjeta verde en 2026 enfrentan un arbol de decision de tres niveles conformado por la barra federal de Medicaid de 5 anos y los programas especificos del estado. Nivel 1: exencion de Medicaid primero. Refugiados, asylees, veteranos y personas con 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU. califican para Medicaid completo inmediatamente, gratis, todo el ano. Nivel 2: programa estatal si el ingreso es bajo y esta en el periodo de espera de 5 anos. Medi-Cal de California, Plan Esencial de Nueva York, Apple Health de Washington, MassHealth de Massachusetts y HUSKY Health de Connecticut extienden cobertura gratuita o de bajo costo a inmigrantes con presencia legal con ingresos elegibles durante el periodo de espera. Nivel 3: Mercado ACA para todos los demas. Los titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% FPL que viven en un estado sin programa estatal, o que tienen ingresos por encima de los niveles de Medicaid, deben inscribirse en un plan del Mercado dentro del SEP de 60 dias.

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in health insurance after getting my green card?
en.answer: Receiving lawful permanent resident status (a green card) triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov. The 60-day clock starts on the date your green card was approved, which is shown on your Form I-551 or USCIS approval notice. Missing this window means waiting until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026, for coverage starting January 2027, unless another qualifying life event triggers a new SEP.

en.question: What is the 5-year bar and how does it affect my Medicaid eligibility?
en.answer: The 5-year bar is a federal rule under PRWORA 1996 (8 U.S.C. 1612) that blocks most lawful permanent residents who entered the U.S. on or after August 22, 1996, from receiving federally funded Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF, and SSI for five years after gaining qualified immigrant status. The five-year clock starts from your green card approval date. During the waiting period, the ACA Marketplace is still open to you. Exemptions apply to refugees, asylees, Cuban-Haitian entrants, veterans, active-duty service members, and lawful permanent residents with 40 quarters of U.S. work history.

en.question: Can I get ACA Marketplace subsidies during the 5-year Medicaid waiting period?
en.answer: Yes. The ACA Marketplace and its premium tax credits are available to lawfully present immigrants including green card holders during the 5-year Medicaid waiting period. In 2026, subsidies are available to green card holders with income at or above 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 for one person, $33,000 for a family of four). The 400% FPL subsidy ceiling ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of four) returned for 2026. Apply at healthcare.gov within your 60-day SEP window.

en.question: Do my children qualify for Medicaid or CHIP even if I'm in the 5-year waiting period?
en.answer: Possibly yes. Thirty-eight states plus DC waive the 5-year bar for children under the Immigrant Children's Health Improvement Act (ICHIA) option. In those states, income-eligible children can enroll in Medicaid or CHIP year-round regardless of how recently their parent received a green card. CHIP covers children in families with income from roughly 138% to 200-300% FPL depending on the state. Check your state Medicaid agency's website or call the Children's Health Insurance Program helpline (1-877-KIDS-NOW) to confirm eligibility in your state.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove my green card SEP at healthcare.gov?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov requires proof of the qualifying event for a Special Enrollment Period. For the green card SEP, upload a clear copy of your Form I-551 (the green card itself) showing the approval or issue date, or your USCIS Form I-797 approval notice for adjustment of status. You will also need your Social Security number (or ITIN if SSN is pending), proof of U.S. address, and income documentation for subsidy calculation. Submit the SEP application within the 60-day window from the date on your green card document.

en.question: Will applying for ACA health insurance or Medicaid hurt my immigration status?
en.answer: No. Under current USCIS rules in 2026, receiving ACA Marketplace premium tax credits, CHIP, Medicaid for individuals under 21, Medicaid during pregnancy and postpartum, Emergency Medicaid, or state-funded health programs does NOT count against you in a public charge determination. USCIS updated its public charge rule in 2022 to clarify that these programs are excluded. Only receipt of cash-based programs like SSI or TANF, or long-term institutionalization under Medicaid, factors into public charge for green card applicants.

en.question: What happens after my 5-year waiting period ends?
en.answer: Once five years have passed from your green card approval date, you may apply for Medicaid through your state Medicaid agency or healthcare.gov. Medicaid enrollment is year-round in all 40 expansion states. If your income is at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 for one person, $45,540 for a family of four in 2026), you will likely qualify for free or very low-cost Medicaid. Transition from a Marketplace plan to Medicaid counts as a qualifying life event, so you will have a Special Enrollment Period to disenroll from Marketplace coverage without penalty.

en.question: Which states offer coverage to green card holders during the 5-year waiting period?
en.answer: As of 2026, the states with the broadest state-funded coverage during the 5-year bar are California (Medi-Cal), New York (Essential Plan), Washington (Apple Health), Massachusetts (MassHealth), Connecticut (HUSKY Health), and Vermont (Green Mountain Care). Illinois covers immigrant children and seniors. Oregon Health Plan also extends some state-funded coverage. Rules changed significantly in 2025-2026, so contact your state Medicaid agency directly to confirm current eligibility and enrollment processes for lawfully present immigrants during the federal 5-year waiting period.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en seguro de salud despues de obtener mi tarjeta verde?
es.answer: Recibir el estatus de residente permanente legal (una tarjeta verde) activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. El reloj de 60 dias comienza en la fecha en que se aprobo su tarjeta verde, que se muestra en su Formulario I-551 o aviso de aprobacion de USCIS. Si pierde esta ventana significa esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta de ACA en noviembre de 2026, para cobertura que comienza en enero de 2027, a menos que otro evento calificador de vida active un nuevo SEP.

es.question: Que es la barra de 5 anos y como afecta mi elegibilidad para Medicaid?
es.answer: La barra de 5 anos es una regla federal bajo PRWORA 1996 que bloquea a la mayoria de los residentes permanentes legales que entraron a los EE.UU. el 22 de agosto de 1996 o despues de recibir Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF y SSI financiados federalmente durante cinco anos despues de obtener el estatus de inmigrante calificado. El reloj de cinco anos comienza desde la fecha de aprobacion de su tarjeta verde. Durante el periodo de espera, el Mercado ACA sigue abierto para usted. Las exenciones aplican a refugiados, asylees, entrants cubanos-haitianos, veteranos, militares activos y residentes permanentes legales con 40 trimestres de historial laboral en EE.UU.

es.question: Puedo obtener subsidios del Mercado ACA durante el periodo de espera de Medicaid de 5 anos?
es.answer: Si. El Mercado ACA y sus creditos fiscales de prima estan disponibles para inmigrantes con presencia legal, incluidos los titulares de tarjeta verde, durante el periodo de espera de Medicaid de 5 anos. En 2026, los subsidios estan disponibles para titulares de tarjeta verde con ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 para una persona, $33,000 para una familia de cuatro). Aplique en healthcare.gov dentro de su ventana SEP de 60 dias.

es.question: Mis hijos califican para Medicaid o CHIP aunque yo este en el periodo de espera de 5 anos?
es.answer: Posiblemente si. Treinta y ocho estados mas DC renuncian a la barra de 5 anos para ninos bajo la Ley de Mejora de Salud para Ninos Inmigrantes (ICHIA). En esos estados, los ninos con ingresos elegibles pueden inscribirse en Medicaid o CHIP todo el ano independientemente de hace cuanto tiempo sus padres recibieron una tarjeta verde. CHIP cubre a ninos en familias con ingresos de aproximadamente 138% a 200-300% FPL dependiendo del estado. Verifique el sitio web de la agencia de Medicaid de su estado o llame a la linea de ayuda del Programa de Seguro de Salud Infantil (1-877-KIDS-NOW).

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar mi SEP de tarjeta verde en healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov requiere prueba del evento calificador para un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial. Para el SEP de tarjeta verde, cargue una copia clara de su Formulario I-551 (la tarjeta verde misma) que muestre la fecha de aprobacion o emision, o su aviso de aprobacion del Formulario I-797 de USCIS para ajuste de estatus. Tambien necesitara su numero de Seguro Social (o ITIN si el SSN esta pendiente), prueba de domicilio en EE.UU. y documentacion de ingresos para el calculo de subsidios.

es.question: Solicitar seguro de salud ACA o Medicaid perjudicara mi estatus migratorio?
es.answer: No. Bajo las reglas actuales de USCIS en 2026, recibir creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA, CHIP, Medicaid para personas menores de 21 anos, Medicaid durante el embarazo y posparto, Medicaid de emergencia o programas de salud financiados por el estado NO cuenta en contra de usted en una determinacion de carga publica. USCIS actualizo su regla de carga publica en 2022 para aclarar que estos programas estan excluidos. Solo la recepcion de programas basados en efectivo como SSI o TANF cuenta para la carga publica para solicitantes de tarjeta verde.

es.question: Que sucede despues de que termine mi periodo de espera de 5 anos?
es.answer: Una vez que hayan transcurrido cinco anos desde la fecha de aprobacion de su tarjeta verde, puede solicitar Medicaid a traves de la agencia de Medicaid de su estado o healthcare.gov. La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano en los 40 estados de expansion. Si sus ingresos son iguales o inferiores al 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona, $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026), probablemente calificara para Medicaid gratuito o de muy bajo costo. La transicion de un plan del Mercado a Medicaid cuenta como un evento calificador de vida.

es.question: Que estados ofrecen cobertura para titulares de tarjeta verde durante el periodo de espera de 5 anos?
es.answer: A partir de 2026, los estados con la cobertura estatal mas amplia durante la barra de 5 anos son California (Medi-Cal), Nueva York (Plan Esencial), Washington (Apple Health), Massachusetts (MassHealth), Connecticut (HUSKY Health) y Vermont (Green Mountain Care). Illinois cubre a ninos inmigrantes y personas mayores. Oregon Health Plan tambien extiende alguna cobertura financiada por el estado. Las reglas cambiaron significativamente en 2025-2026, asi que comuniquese directamente con la agencia de Medicaid de su estado para confirmar la elegibilidad y los procesos de inscripcion actuales.
